headline: 2 jailed after BNP leader Abul Bashar murdered in Adabor
summary: The killing reportedly occurred during celebrations for Brazil's victory in a football match.
details: Two suspects, including the primary accused, have been jailed in connection with the murder of BNP leader Abul Bashar in Adabor.
The incident reportedly took place during celebrations following a Brazil victory in a football match.
Following the killing, a case was filed and police subsequently detained 10 individuals for questioning.
The two primary suspects were produced before a court and sent to jail as investigations continue.
caption:
A football celebration turned deadly in Adabor, leading to the murder of a BNP leader.

Two suspects, including the primary accused, have been jailed in connection with the murder of BNP leader Abul Bashar in Adabor.

The incident reportedly took place during celebrations following a Brazil victory in a football match.

Following the killing, a case was filed and police subsequently detained 10 individuals for questioning.

The two primary suspects were produced before a court and sent to jail as investigations continue.

headline_marked: Mohamed Salah [[starts for Egypt against Australia]] in World Cup clash
headline: Mohamed Salah starts for Egypt against Australia in World Cup clash
summary: The Egyptian captain returns to the starting XI in the Round of 32 encounter in Texas after recovering from a hamstring niggle.
details: Egypt's captain and talisman Mohamed Salah has been named in the starting lineup for the World Cup Round of 32 match against Australia in Texas.
The 34-year-old former Liverpool attacker had previously suffered a hamstring niggle, which forced him to leave Egypt's final group game against Iran.
Coach Hossam Hassan had expressed uncertainty regarding Salah's fitness on Thursday, but ultimately included him in the starting XI alongside Manchester City's Omar Marmoush.
Salah has recorded one goal and two assists so far in the tournament held in North America, averaging a goal every other game for his national team.
Both Egypt and Australia are vying to win their first-ever World Cup knockout game as they face off at the home of the Dallas Cowboys.
The winner of this match will advance to the last 16, where they will face either the reigning champions Argentina or debutants Cape Verde.
caption:
Mohamed Salah is back! The Egyptian captain starts the high-stakes World Cup clash against Australia.

Egypt's captain and talisman Mohamed Salah has been named in the starting lineup for the World Cup Round of 32 match against Australia in Texas.

The 34-year-old former Liverpool attacker had previously suffered a hamstring niggle, which forced him to leave Egypt's final group game against Iran.

Coach Hossam Hassan had expressed uncertainty regarding Salah's fitness on Thursday, but ultimately included him in the starting XI alongside Manchester City's Omar Marmoush.

Salah has recorded one goal and two assists so far in the tournament held in North America, averaging a goal every other game for his national team.

Both Egypt and Australia are vying to win their first-ever World Cup knockout game as they face off at the home of the Dallas Cowboys.

The winner of this match will advance to the last 16, where they will face either the reigning champions Argentina or debutants Cape Verde.

#WorldCup #MohamedSalah #Egypt #Australia #Football #Soccer

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News, The Daily Star
